title: Global-sections pullback and one geometric stalk
statement: For any morphism g:Y→X of schemes and geometric point y:Spec Ω→Y with Ω algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], and any abelian étale sheaf F on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], there is an isomorphism c:(g⁻¹F)_y≅F_(y g) [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. The composite of the canonical global-sections pullback [def-weil-pbc-finite-section-pullback], evaluation at the identity étale object of Y, its germ at y, and c equals evaluation at the identity étale object of X followed by the germ at y g. Evaluation uses Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections and the explicit terminal proof MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal.

source.place: Degree-zero proof, inverse-image stalk and germ compatibility; Stacks Tag 03Q1 (3).

proof.text: Take the inverse-image stalk isomorphism and its germ compatibility. Evaluate it at the identity étale neighbourhood. The definition of globalSectionsUpperStarMap evaluates the adjunction unit at the chosen terminal object and then restricts along its base-change terminal isomorphism. Transport terminal evaluations to the identity objects by the unique terminal isomorphisms; naturality of evaluation and the point-colimit relation toPresheafFiber_w identify the induced germ with the identity-neighbourhood germ. Apply inverseImage_stalk_germ to obtain the displayed equality.

theorem exists_globalSections_stalk_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ c : (pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.obj (((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) ≅
        (pointSmallEtale (y ≫ g)).sheafFiber.obj F,
      globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g F ≫
        (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _ (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale Y)).hom.app
          (((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) ≫
        (pointSmallEtale y).toPresheafFiber (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y))
          (Over.homMk y (Category.comp_id y))
          (((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F).obj ≫ c.hom =
      (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _ (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale X)).hom.app F ≫
        (pointSmallEtale (y ≫ g)).toPresheafFiber (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))
          (Over.homMk (y ≫ g) (Category.comp_id (y ≫ g))) F.obj
